subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF NORWAY
text:
U1422/26 NOTAMR U0928/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2610200559 C)2701202359 EST
E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF NORWAY
AS TO ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT AND ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED,
OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE
(AOC) ISSUED BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO
ENTER, EXIT AND OVERFLY AIRSPACE OVER TERRITORY OF NORWAY (AIP
SUP 12/2024),
AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY DECLARE THAT
ALL ACFT REGISTERED IN NORWAY AS WELL AS ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS OF NORWAY, OR BY OPERATORS
HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFCIATE (AOC) ISSUED BY AUTHORITIES OF
NORWAY, ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OVER
TERRITORY OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION EXCEPT FOR ACFT IN EMERG, HUM OR
MEDICAL FLIGHTS AND CASES, WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR OPS IS
GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN
AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS APPROPRIATE.
